params.prompt: One uninterrupted fixed-camera close-up of this exact older woman in the same workshop. Keep her loosely tied gray hair, earrings, worn tan-brown shirt, seated forward posture, soft daylight and the buyer's blue shoulder at the right foreground. She looks screen-right at him. Begin with her eyes raised, comfortable and ready to answer. One primary action: after about 0.5 seconds she starts a brief answer with small natural conversational mouth movement, then interrupts herself. Continue her raised gaze and ordinary answer until about 4.8 seconds. Between about 4.8 and 5.8 seconds her mouth closes and her eyes lower slightly toward the table; any small hand movement settles. Hold the unresolved pause through 8 seconds. The buyer remains patiently seated and still in his established position, including his foreground shoulder; he does not withdraw or leave. No audible character dialogue or exact words. Preserve identity, geography and all objects. No extra paper, writing, new props, early worried look, gasp, theatrical sadness, second answer, smile recovery, head shake or gaze to lens. Camera, framing and light stay fixed. End quietly considering with lowered eyes and closed mouth.

The exact presenter in the reference speaks directly to the camera using the supplied audio, preserving every spoken word and pause and the original voice. Keep his recognizable face, clear glasses, navy shirt, study, window light, desk and framing unchanged. Neutral, matter-of-fact delivery. His head stays upright and centered, chin level, shoulders relaxed and quiet. Small precise lip movement follows the actual syllables, with relaxed jaw and brows and natural blinking. Expression comes from subtle eyes and lips, not speech-timed head dips. Keep forearms supported and hands relaxed in their starting position; incidental small finger movement is sufficient, with no required hand gesture. Fixed camera. No nodding accents on straight or never, broad smile, exaggerated articulation, head sway, leaning, new props, face reshaping or wardrobe change. Finish naturally after the complete final word. Use only the supplied speech audio; no music, ambience, additional speech or sound effects. The audio is 5.6 seconds; the final 0.4 second is a natural silent hold, not slowed speech.
